standard.summary: DreamBooth 的 use_lora 开启时使用的 LoRA 秩（rank）。默认 16。是 network_dim 在 DreamBooth 路线上的别名入口。
standard.effect: 队列侧解析配置时把本值写入 network_dim（use_lora=true 时 network_dim = lora_rank），后续 adapter 注入按该 rank 构建低秩矩阵。
standard.whenToUse: 单主体 DreamBooth 通常 8~32 足够；细节复杂的主体（服饰、纹身）可提高到 32~64。
standard.avoidWhen: use_lora 关闭（全参模式）时无效；盲目拉高 rank 只会增大产物体积和过拟合风险。

standard_en.summary: The LoRA rank used when DreamBooth's use_lora is on. Default 16. It is the DreamBooth route's alias entry for network_dim.
standard_en.effect: While the queue side parses the config it writes this into network_dim (with use_lora=true, network_dim = lora_rank), and adapter injection then builds the low-rank matrices at that rank.
standard_en.whenToUse: 8-32 is usually enough for a single-subject DreamBooth; subjects with complex detail (clothing, tattoos) can go to 32-64.
standard_en.avoidWhen: It has no effect with use_lora off (full-parameter mode), and raising rank blindly only grows the artefact and the overfitting risk.

advanced.principle: rank 决定 ΔW = B·A 的秩上限，即可学习子空间的维度。DreamBooth 场景目标是绑定单一主体，本征维度低，小 rank 即可覆盖且自带正则化效果。
advanced.intervention: training_queue_support.py：training_type=dreambooth 且 use_lora 时 network_dim = int(lora_rank or network_dim or 16)；field_alias_map.py 把 lora_rank 别名映射到 network_dim。
advanced.expectedImpact: rank 翻倍 → 产物体积与 LoRA 参数量近似翻倍；质量收益在 16~32 后趋于平缓。
advanced.tradeoffs: 与通用路线的 network_dim 是同一自由度的两个入口，混用两个键时以 DreamBooth 队列解析的合并结果为准。

advanced_en.principle: Rank caps the rank of ΔW = B·A — the dimensionality of the learnable subspace. DreamBooth's goal is binding a single subject with low intrinsic dimension, so a small rank suffices and self-regularizes.
advanced_en.intervention: training_queue_support.py: when training_type=dreambooth and use_lora, network_dim = int(lora_rank or network_dim or 16); field_alias_map.py maps the lora_rank alias onto network_dim.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Doubling rank roughly doubles artifact size and LoRA parameter count; quality gains flatten after 16~32.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: It is the same degree of freedom as network_dim on the generic route via a second entry point; when both keys are set, the DreamBooth queue's merged resolution wins.
advanced_en.codePath: training_queue_support.py: use_lora branch network_dim=lora_rank; field_alias_map.py:'lora_rank'→'network_dim'; defined in configs_dataset.py
